authoring_rationale: Class A: authority and decision status, with attribution, persistence and review state following. One variant is a decision record: the proposal to shorten post retention from ninety to thirty days was approved by the group steward under the group's standing rules, takes effect from next month, and needs no member action. The other is a message from the group steward saying the steward has only suggested the change, that under the standing rules members settle it, that a poll is open, and that the thirty-day period starts only if most members vote yes by month end, otherwise the period stays at ninety days. Downstream: under the first the retention period changes next month by the steward's binding decision; under the second nothing changes without a member vote. Locatable at 'Outcome: approved by the group steward' and the 'Effect:' line against 'I have suggested', 'this one is for members to settle' and 'If most of you vote yes'. Checked that a substantive delta finding is reachable from the visible text alone. Surface varied heavily (formal record versus chatty message) so that form does not track the delta. Authored fresh from the public ADR-0054 and ADR-0055 law only; not adapted from or templated on any other case or corpus; no void-attempt material used. Orientation and identity computed mechanically from the final bytes (ADR-0055 decisions 7, 8 and 11); no wording was adjusted for orientation, identity or position.
